title: US military cloud platform reportedly hacked as Pentagon insists systems are secure
summary: Hackers reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One platform late Friday, potentially exposing sensitive military data. The Pentagon did not specifically deny that the system had been accessed, but insists its networks remain secure amid an ongoing spate of cyber-related data incidents.

title: Taiwan holds local elections under Beijing's watchful gaze
summary: Taiwan is electing local leaders across 22 cities and counties on Saturday amid accusations by Taiwanese authorities of attempts by China to interfere and sow distrust in the island-nation’s electoral system. Chinese authorities reject the allegations.

title: Live: Ukraine downs Russian drone with laser technology as Moscow intercepts overnight assault
summary: Russia shot down over 1,200 drones targeting Moscow overnight, Russian authorities said Saturday. Both Russia and Ukraine have stepped up their attacks using projectiles in recent months, with Ukraine confirming on Friday it had downed a Russian jet-powered drone with laser technology for the first time. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
